title: Ground somersault · load → release → inversion → catch

source.title: Ground flip (1080p 120fps - take 02).webm
source.origin: Own work uploaded by PoseidonSports to Wikimedia Commons
source.author: PoseidonSports
source.rights_note: Source frames were used only as analysis evidence. No source pixels, copied frames, or source audio are embedded in the repo example or its MP4; the output is an abstract ASCII rig encoding general motion facts with provenance and attribution retained.
source.presentation_cadence_note: The Commons source is categorized as slow motion. OBSERVED timestamps below are source presentation timestamps, not claims about real-world athletic duration or cadence.
source.whole_action_inspection: OBSERVED: the entire 6.008 s source was decoded and inspected as an ordered 2 fps whole-clip preview before keys were chosen; the coherent action core was then inspected at ordered 4 fps over 2.000–4.000 s. Source pixels remained analysis-only.

observed: The performer begins the selected action in a compressed stance, then extends through a long preparation before leaving grounded support.
At 2.500 s the performer is still upright near the ground plane; by 3.000 s the body is clearly airborne/rotating, so exact toe-off is bracketed rather than invented.
At 3.250 s the body is visibly inverted/tucked with the root/pelvis proxy above the head path.
At 3.500 s the body is descending/unfolding toward the ground plane.
By 3.750 s ground support has visibly returned and the torso is substantially upright; exact first foot-strike side/frame remains unresolved.
Horizontal root travel is small relative to the vertical/rotational excursion; the action reads primarily as an on-the-spot vertical arc plus rotation.
inferred: The compiled animation cadence is authored with PoseLab FOURS/TWOS/ONES/STREET_FIGHTER-CAPCOM vocabulary because the source is slow-motion presentation and real-time performance cadence is not established.
Connective joint interpolation between decisive observed poses is deterministic geometry only and carries the prior key's semantic state until the next decisive key.
unknown: Exact toe-off frame between 2.500 and 3.000 s at the inspected resolution
Exact first landing foot/strike frame between 3.500 and 3.750 s
Exact hand contact state during the rotation
Real-world performance duration represented by the slow-motion presentation

keys.contact_note: Feet remain at ground plane; side/weight split unresolved.
keys.root_arc_note: Root low; knees/hips compressed; stored vertical impulse begins here.
Root rises; upper limbs sweep upward/forward while body lengthens.

keys.contact_note: Body remains upright adjacent to ground plane; exact departure has not yet been promoted.
keys.root_arc_note: Root high and nearly over the takeoff footprint; horizontal drift remains small.

keys.contact_note: Release transition is visually underway, but exact toe-off is not resolved; semantic support is held closed until K4.
keys.root_arc_note: Root begins the airborne arc and torso tips into rotation.

keys.contact_note: No ground support visible; hand contact remains unresolved and is not encoded.
keys.root_arc_note: Root is above the ground plane; body axis is strongly rotated and compacting.

keys.contact_note: Ground support absent; no hand-ground contact claim is promoted.
keys.root_arc_note: Root/pelvis proxy sits above the head path; legs fold overhead in the clearest inversion sample.

keys.contact_note: Feet approach the ground plane; first landing contact is not yet resolved.
keys.root_arc_note: Root descends while torso rotates back toward upright and limbs lengthen to prepare the catch.

keys.contact_note: Ground support has returned by this sample; exact first foot-strike side/frame is bracketed 3.500–3.750 s.
keys.root_arc_note: Root catches low enough to absorb and then returns toward an upright stack with little horizontal displacement.

timing.key_timing_policy: OBSERVED source presentation timestamps for decisive evidence keys; they are not real-time athletic cadence claims.
timing.pose_lab_vocabulary_note: Compile cadence is INFERRED with FOURS/TWOS/ONES/STREET_FIGHTER-CAPCOM. User shorthand 1s/2s/4s means these classes, never seconds.
timing.compile_frame_policy: Explicit authored compile_frame targets compress the slow-motion reference into a readable animation study without pretending to recover real-time source cadence.

motion_dungeon.transition_rule: Only authored joint geometry interpolates. support_state/contact_note/root_arc_note remain owned by the prior key until the next key. causal_boundary_to_next=true forbids interpolation across unresolved support/contact transitions and holds the prior key until a discrete state change.
